dct_description_sm: This dataset represents a validation study examining cortical activity using functional near-infrared spectroscopy during distracted walking. We compare activity during virtual obstacle navigation using augmented reality to activity during physical obstacle navigation.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for Prefrontal cortex activity during virtual obstacle avoidance and distracted walking: a methodological proof of concept using augmented reality and functional near-infrared spectroscopy
